# Packs

<!-- Generated from the engine code by `make docs`: do not edit by hand. -->

Each shop sells 2 packs besides its cards; rerolls keep them. A bought pack
opens on the spot: pick its cards, or skip it. Themes and commands are used
on the spot (coreutils draws a hand from the deck for its commands), cards
join the deck, jokers the row.

| Id | Pack | Holds | Quip |
|---|---|---|---|
| `coreutils` | coreutils | commands | *ls, cp, mv… pick one.* |
| `base16` | base16 | themes | *Sixteen colors. Pick a vibe.* |
| `base_devel` | base-devel | cards | *Everything you need to build a deck.* |
| `jokers_git` | jokers-git | jokers | *Unstable, untested, irresistible.* |

| Size | Suffix | Picks | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `normal` | `—` | 1 of 3 (jokers: one fewer) | $4 |
| `full` | `-full` | 1 of 5 (jokers: one fewer) | $6 |
| `meta` | `-meta` | 2 of 5 (jokers: one fewer) | $8 |
